findings.detail: C107 negative-cost warning is firing on source-disclosed parenthesized amortized cost for revolving loan rows with no market value, not on an extraction error.

rationale: The flag reports negative cost values such as -12191 for Electro Methods. Raw SOI table 36 shows the same row under the Amortized Cost column as parenthesized (12,191) with par/shares '-' and market value '-', and the same pattern appears for Tronair, Whitcraft, and Engine & Transmission Exchange revolving loan rows. The extracted signed costs therefore match the source; the advisory C107 check is overbroad for these source-disclosed unfunded/revolving cost balances.
